name: Giant Scorpion
descr: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

features.name: Venomous Stinger
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, **spend a Fear** to deal **1d4+4** physical damage and _Poison_ them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While _Poisoned_, the target must roll a **d6** before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
